summary: Validated (a) admin-only delete-employee flow and (b) full removal of daily expenses. Backend: refactored /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py to drop obsolete expense assertions (test_admin_cannot_post_expense, test_expense_uses_signed_identity, /expenses in _id leak scan) and added a new TestAdminDeleteEmployee class + test_expense_endpoints_removed + test_employee_blocked_from_delete_employee + activity/dashboard assertions that expenses/today_expenses are absent. 53/54 tests pass; the single failing test (test_employee_quick_add_creates_vendor asserting a non-empty phone placeholder) is a pre-existing assertion mismatch unrelated to this task (Vendor.phone defaults to empty string when created via quick-add). Frontend UI: admin portal shows no expense text/testids, delete-employee-<id> buttons render for every employee, admin created TEST_UIDelete and successfully deleted it (row disappears, no console errors). Employee portal (Raj Mehta) shows no expense testids/text, no delete-employee buttons, collection entry panel and dashboard still function. Mobile viewport (390x844) has no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390).

minor.issue: Vendor returned by quick-add has empty phone ('') — pre-existing; unrelated to current task; test asserts truthy placeholder. Either seed placeholder phone or update test assertion.

action_items: (Optional/pre-existing) Fix quick-vendor placeholder phone OR relax the assertion in test_employee_quick_add_creates_vendor.
critical_code_review_comments: router.py: /api/employees DELETE cascades users + soft-deletes files correctly, but does NOT delete/anonymise collections. Historical collections remain queryable by employee_id after deletion — acceptable per requirement (do not break historical data), just be aware.

activity endpoint still returns `collections` for a deleted employee's id path only through admin route (employee itself is gone), so 404 on activity would be preferable to a partial payload — currently deleting employee returns 404 correctly.

AdminPortal.jsx uses window.confirm (or none) inside removeEmployee — verified via UI test that click completes without confirmation dialog blocking it. Consider a confirm-dialog for accidental deletes.
backend_test.py is one large 500-line file; consider splitting into per-domain test modules for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted a transient employee TEST_UIDelete via admin UI; backend pytest also creates TEST_AuthEmp / TEST_DeleteMe / TEST_OtherEmp fixtures per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Expenses feature is fully removed on both server (no /api/expenses routes, no today_expenses in dashboard, no expenses key in employee activity) and frontend (zero expense-* testids, zero expense text on both portals). Admin delete flow uses data-testid=delete-employee-{id}; employee role gets 403 on DELETE /api/employees/{id}. Reuse /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — TestAdminDeleteEmployee + test_expense_endpoints_removed cover the new contract.
rca of the issue: Not a bug fix iteration — feature-removal + admin-only delete verification. Prior iteration_7 test suite still referenced deprecated expense endpoints; updating the suite was required so it accurately reflects the new contract. All product behaviour matches the spec.
